title: Source list
description: The knowledge sources the Knowledge Curator has chosen for one application. AI-drafted specification rules may only use these sources, and every rule must cite one. Kept in the application's main repo as testing/sources.yaml, or in the organisation repo.

curator.description: The Knowledge Curator: a person or team.

id.description: Descriptive key, used in rule citations.

location.description: Where it is: an exported file path, a page space, a tracker query, a repo. The AI assistant reads only what people export or make reachable.

currency.description: How far the source can be trusted to reflect today's system.

as_of_version.description: The version, revision or commit the export represents, so citations can point at it.
